faqs.a:
Section 3310.3.2. Surface,
is hereby added to read as follows:
"3310.3.2. Surface.
Temporary fire apparatus access roads shall have an all-weather surface consisting
                  of the first lift of asphalt, concrete, alternative design as approved by a geotechnical
                  engineer. The surface shall be capable of supporting an 85,000 pound imposed load,
                  all weather maintainable and free from obstructions. Documentation from a licensed
                  civil engineer attesting that the surface will support the required imposed load shall
                  be provided."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
